# ---- Simulate a source operator with checkpointed offsets + idempotent sink ----
checkpoint_dir = {}          # committed state: {partition: next_offset}
sink_seen_event_ids = set()  # idempotency key store in the sink

def process_batch(batch, crash_after=None):
    """Consume a batch; stop early to simulate a crash mid-batch."""
    for i, row in batch.iterrows():
        # at-least-once redelivery is allowed, but dedup guarantees exactly-once
        if row.event_id not in sink_seen_event_ids:
            sink_seen_event_ids.add(row.event_id)          # atomic write w/ dedup key
        checkpoint_dir[row.partition] = row.partition_offset + 1   # advance cursor
        if crash_after is not None and i == crash_after:
            raise RuntimeError("simulated crash")

# Batch 1: all of p1 up to o2, then crash before committing o3
p1 = df[df.partition == 1]
try:
    process_batch(p1.iloc[:3], crash_after=1)   # processes o0, o1 then crashes
except RuntimeError as e:
    print("CRASH:", e)

print("\ncheckpoint after crash (next_offset per partition):", checkpoint_dir)
print("rows actually in sink:", len(sink_seen_event_ids))

# ---- Restart: resume each partition strictly from its committed next_offset ----
remaining = df[~df.event_id.isin(sink_seen_event_ids)]
print("\nredelivered rows on restart (uncommitted only):")
print(remaining[["version","partition","partition_offset","event_id"]].to_string(index=False))

# reprocess everything not yet in the sink
for _, row in remaining.iterrows():
    sink_seen_event_ids.add(row.event_id)
    checkpoint_dir[row.partition] = row.partition_offset + 1

final = (df.assign(delivered=df.event_id.isin(sink_seen_event_ids))
           .groupby("partition")
           .agg(events=("event_id","size"),
                delivered=("delivered","sum"),
                last_committed_offset=("partition_offset","max"))
           .reset_index())
final["next_offset"] = final.last_committed_offset + 1

print("\nFINAL PARTITION STATE")
print(final.to_string(index=False))
print("\ntotal delivered:", len(sink_seen_event_ids), "of", len(df),
      "| duplicates:", len(df) - len(sink_seen_event_ids) if len(sink_seen_event_ids) <= len(df) else 0,
      "| lost:", len(df) - len(sink_seen_event_ids))
print("exactly-once:", set(df.event_id) == sink_seen_event_ids)
